newsitem.title: USA: Sk Telecom files to offer $230 mln in notes.
newsitem.headline: Sk Telecom files to offer $230 mln in notes.

text.p: Sk Telecom Co Ltd filed Wednesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to offer up to $230 million in notes due 2007.

Korea's leading wireless telecommunication service provider said it will use the proceeds from the sale to finance a portion of its purchase of a 20 percent interest in Wireless Communication Services, a licensed cellular mobile telecommunications services provider based in Thailand.
Underwriters for the offering are Merrill Lynch & Co, Goldman Sachs & Co., Salomon Brothers Inc and Smith Barney Inc.
